title: Thrombin receptor signalling via PAR1 tethered-ligand mechanism
fulltext_excerpt: Thrombin activates platelets via PAR1 cleavage of the extracellular tethered ligand domain exposing a new amino terminus that acts as a tethered ligand activating downstream signalling cascades through G-protein-coupled receptor mechanisms.
